title: can anyone relate ??
content: Hey guys so I know this might sound crazy but it is the mall world group so can’t be that crazy.. but I do dream of the mall world every night, I’m conscious I am there but I am not feeling as if I am fully lucid or doing AP but I can’t help notice that I may not be able to generate conversations with people k find I am more of like watching a movie but am just walking forward to the next parts of my dreams. I’ll break down my spots. •the mall = the mall world can be different sometimes in size, sometimes long and endless and sometimes short and easy to run through. I usually remember all the clothes and food when I wake up and seems to always be in style of what I’m into at that time. Never have to pay just walk in try whatever I want. •the water hotel = like a hotel on the water front with three big pools at the front, and a bar sitting on the front of the hotel. Then you can walk in from the bar upto the curvy stairs that have little rooms which sometimes I stay in. The water hotel seems to be in the middle of no where tho seems to be a train that links everything together. •train station = the train station is weird it’s like super futuristic and I find myself always walking on the tracks trying to get around to other platforms as they get mixed up alot. • water park/theme park= I hear a lot of people talking about a theme park. Mines not usually a theme park but more or so like a survival course. Always above big pools of water more like damns. • the island = lately I’ve been getting a boat from the train station (don’t know how that works) but it is crystal clear water and lush beautiful green hill sides that would look like Fiji or a tropical mountainy island. • the house in woods = I usually find I’m always with a partner or someone’s family here and there’s always something upstairs in the house that’s creepy n weird so I avoid it. Weird though the other day I had a dream where I was in the house and chased by a tall man. Today I watched a TikTok video about “it follows” where the tall man is around. I do have prediction dreams and I swear the tall dude looked exactly like that tall guy in that. I wonder if you guys have also seen entities like this? I’m usually never scared or wake up from dreams but second I saw his eyes I woke up. • the ally way = I dream of this ally way in a city like scape and it has all little shops and restaurants that look like Japan. •The long empty roads = I find in between all these spots are just bland boring straight roads that I find I’m either running or driving down. These spots I call limbo as I think I am either generating the next spot or I am deciding where I’m gonna go. I’m starting to get really confused and it’s taking over my life everyday sometimes I wish I could be there as an escape and I’m trying to sleep to be there. Would be great if we could all do a research paper together or something! As this shit is way too weird. I believe we are going to an astral plane that some of us are more aware of than others. I was wondering if anyone has any tips also about how I can get these entities to fk off 😂 or can anyone give me any tips on how I can control them more as in asking people in my dreams who they actually are. I’m going to do some ai stuff today and make some pics.
